install_tell: apachepulsar/pulsar:latest standalone quickstart — authenticationEnabled=false shipped default, tenant "public"/namespace "default" auto-created
misconfig_patterns: authenticationEnabled=false (shipped default) with admin API reachable
/metrics Prometheus endpoint open regardless of authorization config when authenticationEnabled=false

response_markers: bare JSON array of cluster names
active_probe.false_positive_check: response must be a JSON array of strings under /admin/v2/ path prefix

deployment_tells: standalone quickstart naming (public/default) is highly consistent, making topic-path guessing trivial
6650 binary broker port often open alongside 8080 admin
pivot_paths: unauth admin API -> create/delete tenants/namespaces/topics, alter retention/replication policy
unauth client connect on 6650 -> consume any topic
Pulsar Functions config read -> embedded creds
